At my age of 68, I have been farming this land for many years and I know what works. This small plot of beans is intercropped, and beans do not need chemical fertilizer like maize does — they fix their own nitrogen from the air. I will use manure that I have collected from my livestock to give the soil some strength, and I will plant the bean seed I saved from last season because it grows well here and I cannot afford to buy new seed every year. There is no money for pesticides or irrigation on this plot, so my family and I will do all the work ourselves with our hoes.
